title: C: Variables & Data Types
description: Declare variables of different types in C: int, float, char, and double. Print their values.

steps.title: Declare Variables
steps.description: Declare an `int age = 25`, a `float price = 9.99`, a `char grade = 'A'`, and a `double pi = 3.14159`. Print each using the correct format specifier.
hints: Use `%d` for int, `%f` for float, `%c` for char, `%lf` for double.

verification.failureMessage: Print age (25), price (9.99), grade (A), and pi (3.14159)
